title: Balanced Brackets
prompt:
Given a string s made only of the characters ( ) [ ] { }, decide whether the brackets are balanced. A string is balanced when every opening bracket is closed by the same kind of bracket, and brackets close in the reverse order they were opened. The empty string is balanced.

Return True or False.

Example:
  is_balanced("{[()]}()") -> True
  is_balanced("([)]") -> False
